basis.data: LibriSpeech dev-clean solo recordings mixed with exact references (CC-BY-4.0)
basis.regions: oracle (ground truth from the mixing plan)
basis.caveat: English, non-Egyptian read speech. Not an Egyptian-Arabic or RTX 3050 result.

info.name: wesep_bsrnn
info.title: REAL-TSE WeSep BSRNN (spk_emb_100, 16 kHz)
info.code_licence: Apache-2.0 (as stated for the project; no LICENSE file was found at the repository root when checked)
info.notes: Conditioned on a WeSpeaker speaker embedding computed from the enrollment audio. Checkpoints are distributed on Google Drive (not Hugging Face).
info.fp16_note: The library call is file based; fp16 autocast is tried and falls back to fp32 on NaN.

info.name: usef_tse
info.title: USEF-TSE (USEF-SepFormer, WSJ0-2mix, 8 kHz)
info.notes: Embedding-free: the enrollment audio is encoded by the same encoder and fused by cross attention. The TFGridNet variant is larger and is not tried (4 GB VRAM).

info.name: spexplus
info.title: ClearerVoice SpEx+ (WSJ0-2mix, 8 kHz)
info.notes: Trained on clean English 2-speaker WSJ0-2mix only: weaker on noise, Arabic and 3+ voices is expected. The audio-only checkpoint lives in the training code, not the clearvoice inference package, so the model class is imported from the pinned source file.
info.fp16_note: fp16 autocast with fp32 fallback. Output level and polarity are arbitrary (scale-invariant training); matched to the mixture by least squares.
